stack.headline: A stack built to ship fast, not to look good on a CV.

projects.title: Spotify Podcast Intelligence
projects.headline: 19 podcasts → daily French notes in my vault, fully unattended.
projects.description: A daily n8n pipeline that listens to podcasts so I don't have to. Every night it polls 19 podcast RSS feeds, picks the fresh episodes, and runs each one through transcription and summarization. Audio is downloaded, compressed with ffmpeg to mono 16kHz/32kbps (to clear Groq's 25MB ceiling), then transcribed by Groq Whisper — which also detects the language. Non-French episodes are auto-translated before Gemini produces a strictly factual French summary (résumé, key points, notable quotes). Each result is written as a self-contained Obsidian note, tracked in Supabase for deduplication, and a Telegram recap closes every run. Built for resilience: dynamic Groq rate-limit retries, oversize-file skips, and per-episode error handlers that never crash the batch.
projects.architecture: Daily cron · RSS 24h filter · ffmpeg compress · Groq Whisper · Gemini summary · Supabase dedup · Telegram recap

projects.title: JobNomad
projects.headline: The job board that catches timezone traps before you apply.
projects.description: 80% of 'remote' jobs hide timezone constraints or foreign contractor blocks in their free text — not in metadata. JobNomad solves this with Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite AI extraction at ingestion: every job is analyzed once, results stored in Supabase. The feed is pure SQL — sub-200ms, zero LLM at query time. Phase 1 MVP: magic-link auth (PKCE), 4-step onboarding with resume, filterable feed with URL-persisted pagination, bookmarks, application tracking, 3 ingestion sources (RemoteOK, WWR, Himalayas), SHA-256 dedup, and weekly cron cleanup keeping DB under Supabase free tier.
projects.architecture: AI extraction at ingestion · SQL feed < 200ms · SHA-256 dedup · PKCE magic-link · pgvector · cron cleanup

projects.title: Instagram Comment-to-DM Automation
projects.headline: Comments become a distribution channel — keyword in, resource in DM.
projects.description: Real-time Instagram automation that turns post comments into a content distribution funnel. Webhook events are routed by type (comment vs DM) through a Switch node, then matched against a Google Sheets keyword registry. On match, the bot replies publicly to the comment AND triggers a dedicated sub-workflow that delivers the corresponding resource via DM through the Instagram Graph API. Anti-spam is built-in at the data layer: a commenter_id + media_id lookup blocks any second trigger on the same post. Adding a new lead magnet means appending a row in Google Sheets — no redeploy.
projects.architecture: Webhook event router · Google Sheets keyword registry · Sheets-based dedupe · Sub-workflow DM distributor

projects.title: AI B2B Outreach Engine
projects.headline: LinkedIn → hyper-personalized messages, fully automated.
projects.description: End-to-end AI pipeline that transforms raw LinkedIn prospect data into multi-touchpoint outreach sequences. 9 sequential AI stages: dual-entry validation, 4 parallel branches (language detection, personalization hooks, knowledge base, touchpoint parsing), buyer classification, strategy generation, message generation, quality gate, and production API delivery with retry logic.
projects.architecture: 9-stage pipeline · 4 parallel branches · 21 LLM nodes · Primary/fallback model per call

projects.title: AI Brand Identity Generator
projects.headline: Brief in → complete brand kit out. 14 specialist AI agents.
projects.description: End-to-end brand identity generator orchestrating 14 specialized AI agents across a fan-out / fan-in topology. Takes a founder brief and produces a complete launch kit: visual identity board, logo concepts, flat label blueprint, packaging photography, retail environment, social media assets, and a website prompt — all cohesive, grounded in one upstream Visual Strategy node.
projects.architecture: 14 specialist agents · fan-out/fan-in topology · scoped input contracts · negative-space prompting

projects.title: AI Content Engine — SalesMind AI
projects.headline: 1 theme/week → 30 platform-native pieces. 6 channels. 85% AI-produced.
projects.description: 12-month content strategy and production engine for SalesMind AI — an AI-powered B2B sales agent. Built the full system: ICP-aligned positioning, 12-month editorial roadmap, Figma design system (55 color tokens, 82 number variables, 49 text styles, light + dark), and a weekly AI-heavy production pipeline. One hero asset per week cascades into carousels, Reels, Threads hooks, YouTube Shorts, Stories, and paid ads across 6 channels — never copy-paste, always platform-native.
projects.architecture: 6-channel editorial spine · 12-month roadmap · Figma token system (light + dark) · AI-assisted production

process.headline: From idea to prod in days. Not months.
process.subheadline: The difference between a standard dev and me: I use Claude at every step. Not as autocomplete — as a decision accelerator. The result is a velocity no solo dev can reach alone.

steps.title: Brief & Scope
steps.description: We define the real problem, not the symptoms. A call or a Google doc is enough. I ask the right questions to avoid 3 weeks of pointless dev.

steps.title: Architecture + Claude
steps.description: I structure the app or workflow with Claude as co-architect. Not to replace thinking — to accelerate it. We ship a solid technical plan in a few hours.

steps.title: Iterative build
steps.description: Short sprints, intermediate deliverables, tight feedback loop. Each feature is tested before moving on. No big bang delivery.

steps.title: Ship & Transfer
steps.description: Deploy, minimal technical doc, video walkthrough if needed. You take over something that runs, not a prototype.

privacyPolicy.meta_description: Learn how Jérôme Delodder collects, uses and protects your personal data on jeromedelodder.com.
privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes our policies and procedures on the collection, use and disclosure of your information when you use the Service and tells you about your privacy rights and how the law protects you. We use your Personal Data to provide and improve the Service. By using the Service, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

subsections.subtitle: Interpretation
subsections.content: The words whose initial letters are capitalized have meanings defined under the following conditions. The following definitions shall have the same meaning regardless of whether they appear in singular or in plural.

subsections.subtitle: Definitions
subsections.content: For the purposes of this Privacy Policy, the following terms apply:
list: Account — a unique account created for you to access our Service or parts of our Service.
Affiliate — an entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a party, where "control" means ownership of 50% or more of the shares, equity interest or other securities.
Company (referred to as "We", "Us" or "Our") — refers to Jérôme Delodder's portfolio.
Cookies — small files placed on your device by a website, containing details of your browsing history.
Country — Belgium.
Device — any device that can access the Service such as a computer, a cell phone or a digital tablet.
Personal Data — any information that relates to an identified or identifiable individual.
Service — refers to the Website.
Service Provider — any natural or legal person who processes data on behalf of the Company.
Usage Data — data collected automatically, either generated by the use of the Service or from the Service infrastructure itself.
Website — Jérôme Delodder's portfolio, accessible from jeromedelodder.com.
You — the individual accessing or using the Service.

sections.title: Collecting and Using Your Personal Data

subsections.subtitle: Types of Data Collected
subsections.content: While using our Service, we may ask you to provide certain personally identifiable information including: email address, first name and last name, phone number. Usage Data is also collected automatically and may include IP address, browser type, pages visited, time and date of visit, time spent on pages, and unique device identifiers.

subsections.subtitle: Tracking Technologies and Cookies
subsections.content: We use Cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our Service. We use both Session Cookies (deleted when you close your browser) and Persistent Cookies for the following purposes:
list: Necessary / Essential Cookies — essential to provide you with services and to enable features. They help authenticate users and prevent fraudulent use of accounts.
Cookies Policy / Notice Acceptance Cookies — identify if users have accepted the use of cookies on the Website.
Functionality Cookies — allow us to remember choices you make when you use the Website, such as login details or language preference.

subsections.subtitle: Use of Your Personal Data
subsections.content: The Company may use Personal Data for the following purposes:
list: To provide and maintain our Service, including to monitor usage.
To manage your Account — to manage your registration as a user of the Service.
For the performance of a contract — the development and compliance of any contract with us.
To contact you — by email, telephone calls, SMS, or other equivalent forms of electronic communication.
To provide you with news, special offers, and general information about other goods, services and events we offer.
To manage your requests — to attend and manage your requests to us.
For business transfers — to evaluate or conduct a merger, divestiture, restructuring, or other sale or transfer of assets.
For other purposes — data analysis, identifying usage trends, improving our Service, products, services and marketing.

sections.title: Retention of Your Personal Data
sections.content: The Company will retain your Personal Data only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. We apply different retention periods based on purpose and legal obligations:
list: Account Information — retained for the duration of your account relationship plus up to 24 months after account closure.
Customer Support Data — support tickets and chat transcripts: up to 24 months from ticket closure.
Website analytics data (cookies, IP addresses, device identifiers) — up to 24 months from the date of collection.
Server logs (IP addresses, access times) — up to 24 months for security monitoring.

sections.title: Transfer of Your Personal Data
sections.content: Your information, including Personal Data, is processed at the Company's operating offices and in any other places where the parties involved in the processing are located. The Company will take all steps reasonably necessary to ensure that your data is treated securely and in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Delete Your Personal Data
sections.content: You have the right to delete or request that we assist in deleting the Personal Data we have collected about you. You may update, amend, or delete your information at any time by signing in to your Account or by contacting us directly.

subsections.subtitle: Business Transactions
subsections.content: If the Company is involved in a merger, acquisition or asset sale, your Personal Data may be transferred. We will provide notice before your Personal Data is transferred and becomes subject to a different Privacy Policy.

subsections.subtitle: Law Enforcement
subsections.content: Under certain circumstances, the Company may be required to disclose your Personal Data if required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities.

subsections.subtitle: Other Legal Requirements
subsections.content: The Company may disclose your Personal Data in the good faith belief that such action is necessary to comply with a legal obligation, protect the rights or property of the Company, prevent wrongdoing in connection with the Service, protect personal safety of users, or protect against legal liability.

sections.title: Security of Your Personal Data
sections.content: The security of your Personal Data is important to us, but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet, or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially reasonable means to protect your Personal Data, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
sections.content: Our Service does not address anyone under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from anyone under the age of 16. If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your child has provided us with Personal Data, please contact us.

sections.title: Links to Other Websites

We strongly advise you to review the Privacy Policy of every site you visit. We have no control over and assume no responsibility for the content, privacy policies or practices of any third-party sites or services.

sections.content: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date. You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes.
